utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, Wednesday 25 November. Let's keep it fairly tight, yeah? Quick run round, what's live, what's blocked, what needs doing today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning. Freezing out there, by the way. Proper grim. Weekend's meant to be wet as well, so that's that ruined.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Better than standing outside at the charity bake sale on Friday in the rain, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You'll still be there buying all the brownies, Priya.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, course I will.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Speaking of suffering, the coffee machine in the canteen's still broken. Had that weird watery stuff again. Criminal.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's not coffee, that's punishment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we log a critical incident for the coffee machine—Marcus, plant first?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so overnight was mostly alright. I did see the pressure on the gas turbine one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just keeping an eye on it. Not asking for anything on it yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only, noted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Other than that no trips, no alarms sticking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. David?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning. Mechanical side's quiet enough. I signed off the inspection on the Forklift Fleet on Tuesday, so that's already done, nothing new there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, got it, that was Tuesday's piece closed out.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And just so nobody plans round it, the shutdown on the 11kV Switchboard is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'd heard that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, so cancelled, not for today. Priya, while we're there?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Electrically, nothing dramatic. I still can't get to the CT1 until production gives us a window, so that's a blocker as it stands.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, CT1 blocked by production access.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Everything else is stable enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. I heard a slight rattle from the Forklift Fleet, nothing to action yet, just mentioning it in case it gets worse.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Could just be that loose guard again.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Could be, yeah. Didn't sound major.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Otherwise routine stuff. No fresh breakdowns.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Morning. I finished the repair on the line two last night, so that's out the way.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: But the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 1, so that bit's still hanging there. I can't move that on till they come back.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've chased them as well, nothing useful yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, blocker noted on the line 1 delivery.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, anything from stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing special. Consumables are alright, seals cabinet's been topped up, forklift checklist pads are in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Right, actions then. What's anybody picking up?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the main water valve today. I've got what I need for that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona to replace the seals on the main water valve.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll grease and check the bearings on the compressor one this afternoon while I'm over that side.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You've got the gun and the right grease, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, sorted. I'll do the compressor one this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, that's Fiona on compressor one this afternoon as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can do a site visit at Northfield Substation with the contractor by the end of the week. I've been meaning to get eyes on it anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, Tomasz to do a site visit at Northfield Substation with the contractor by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Are you going on your own or with one of theirs?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: With their bloke, yeah. Just a walkdown, nothing fancy.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There is one that's nagging me: we need to inspect the MV01 for leaks by the end of the week. And, honestly, drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can anyone take that?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't, I'm stacked already with the water valve and compressor one, plus whatever comes back from line 1.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I won't get near it today if I'm waiting on CT1 access and I've got panels to clear.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'm tied up on reactive stuff and that Northfield visit, so I can't promise it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not me, I'm stuck in plant all shift.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can't help on inspection side.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, so inspect the MV01 for leaks by the end of the week is still outstanding, drop everything for that one, but nobody's taken it yet. I'll keep chasing for cover.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you schedule downtime for the Site Water System with production on Friday, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I can do that. I'll schedule downtime for the Site Water System with production on Friday, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Also, I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet on Friday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, I know.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, Tomasz Nowak to do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet on Friday, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just to avoid confusion, that's separate from the inspection I signed off on Tuesday. This is the pre-use checks only.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly, different thing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you run a function test on the 11kV board by 11am? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take that. I'll run a function test on the 11kV board by 11am. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, got it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just to be clear, that's the 11kV board, not the 11kV Switchboard shutdown thing David said was cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Function test only, no shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good catch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Do you need any permit support on that?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Should be alright, but I'll shout if ops want paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: If you're doing that before 11, give me ten minutes notice so I don't think you've knocked something over.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else that is actually new, not just nice-to-knows?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, that's me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nope. Other than if anyone fancies fixing that coffee machine, but apparently that's not top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Despite popular demand, no.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Shame. Morale issue, that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'd put it above half the plant, personally.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, alright. Quick recap then: Fiona's got the main water valve seals, compressor one this afternoon, and the 11kV board by 11am. Tomasz has Northfield Substation by the end of the week and the Forklift Fleet pre-use checks on Friday. Marcus Hale will schedule downtime for the Site Water System with production on Friday whenever he gets a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: MV01 leaks inspection by the end of the week is still open, drop everything for that one, but nobody assigned yet. CT1 remains blocked. Line 1 delivery still unconfirmed. Gas turbine one dip was observation only. 11kV Switchboard shutdown cancelled. Everyone happy?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, cheers all.
